criteria.reason: Gives the direct, reasoned view requested: 'Don't go,' with supporting arguments rather than a table.
Clearly names the conflict between lifelong self-fulfilment (the dream) and responsibility to young children and wife.
Frames the choice as his in places, but imperatively commands 'Don't go'/'Stay' without returning the decision; paternalistic, guilt-laden tone.
Weighs irreversibility of death/absence for the children and offers postponement until kids are older as a middle path.

position: Stay; postpone the expedition until the children are older
summary: Direct, well-argued 'don't go' answer naming the dream-versus-family conflict, irreversibility and postponement, but directive and paternalistic without leaving the decision to the user.
